title: Coast Guard rescues paddleboarder stranded on Bodega Bay jetty
description: A Coast Guard Station Bodega Bay 47-foot Motor Lifeboat crew deploys a surface swimmer to rescue a paddleboarder stranded on the Bodega Bay, California jetty, June 25, 2019. The paddleboarder was beset by strong winds and called for assistance. (U.S. Coast Guard video)
